name: Judging Others
overview: Scripture instructs believers to refrain from hypocritical and superficial judgment, emphasizing that judging others invites reciprocal judgment (Matthew 7:1; Luke 6:37). True discernment requires self-examination and humility, as Jesus teaches that one must first address personal sin before correcting others (Matthew 7:5; John 8:7). Additionally, believers are called to judge with righteousness rather than by outward appearances (John 7:24), recognizing that condemning others often reveals one's own guilt (Romans 2:1). This guidance underscores a Christ-centered approach to judgment rooted in grace, mercy, and truth.
